📘 Beginner’s Guide to the Martial World

New to Murim? Follow this guide once, then use it as a reference whenever you need a reminder.

Your starting point: You begin in Willowbank Village as an unaffiliated beginner. Build a strong foundation before seeking the great sects and hidden masters.

1. Understand your status

Your Status tab shows your character, current realm and stage, health, Ki, experience, silver and reputation.

  • Life Points: Your health. Rest and healing items restore them.
  • Energy: Your stamina for active actions such as travel, training, missions and challenges. Rest at an inn to recover it.
  • Knowledge: Insight gained from learning, studying manuals and meeting experienced martial artists.
  • Ki: Your internal martial energy. Its maximum grows with every realm and stage; free meditation restores it. Breakthroughs and internal techniques use Ki.
  • Martial experience: Progress toward the next realm requirement.
  • Silver: Currency for services, supplies and opportunities.

2. Your first day: a simple routine

  1. Open Travel and review your current location.
  2. Go to Actions and try Practice Basics or free Meditation.
  3. Take Odd Jobs if you need more silver.
  4. Rest at the inn when you need to recover Energy and health.
  5. Check your Status to see how your character has progressed.

Most activities advance the in-game day, so choose a sensible routine rather than repeating one action without checking your needs.

How to earn Martial Experience

Experience is awarded for meaningful progress: Meditation +3, Practice Basics +9, studying a manual +4, discovering a new manual +6, speaking with an NPC +2 Knowledge (special sparring or controlled exchanges also grant experience), reaching a new region +4 once per region, and completing commissions or quests +12 to +25. Odd jobs and unsuccessful searches give smaller amounts. Rewards are granted when the activity succeeds; repeating a first-time discovery does not award the exploration bonus again.

3. Cultivation and martial realms

Training and cultivation build your progress. Each realm has four stages: Early, Middle, Late and Peak. When you meet the required Martial Experience, full Ki and Knowledge requirement, use Attempt Breakthrough in Actions. Every breakthrough resets Knowledge to 0, and each successive stage and realm requires more Knowledge.

A breakthrough is not guaranteed. Prepare, keep your health in good shape and continue training if you are not ready. Major breakthroughs from Transcendent onward also require a realm-specific pill or elixir, enough Knowledge and a minimum Life Point percentage. Buy medicines in the Inventory tab before attempting them.

Realm path: Third-Rate → Second-Rate → First-Rate → Peak → Transcendent → Grandmaster → Life and Death → Martial Supreme.

4. Manuals and techniques

Use Search for Manuals from Actions to look for martial knowledge. Discoveries are random: rarity, quality and completeness can differ. A manual may have realm requirements, and an incomplete copy may need missing pages before its full potential can be understood.

Open Manuals to acquire a text and complete a short symbol-memory test to comprehend it. Higher-tier manuals use slightly longer patterns; every test gives you two attempts. Higher rarity does not automatically mean a manual is suitable for your current realm.

5. Travel, NPCs and quests

Visit different locations to meet local characters, hear rumours and discover opportunities. Open NPCs to read about people you have encountered, and Quests to review available tasks and rewards. Some characters and opportunities are tied to particular places or progress.

6. Factions and reputation

Your faction, sect and prestigious-family affiliations affect how groups and characters respond to you. Sect membership grants a martial inheritance; family recognition offers a separate legacy bonus. Good and Bad reputation are tracked separately: helpful actions can build trust, while shady choices can make your name feared or unwelcome. Neither path is simply a free bonus—different people may react differently.

7. Inventory and saving

Inventory tracks your silver, herbs, pills and manuals. The game autosaves in the current browser, but use Export Save Code in Chronicle to keep a portable backup. Import that code on another device or browser to continue your journey.

Starting a new life resets your current character. Export your save first if you want to keep it.

Faction progression milestones

At Second-Rate Warrior, pledge to one of the three powers. Your allegiance is required to enter First-Rate. After reaching Peak Realm · Peak Stage, travel to your own faction headquarters. The Transcendent breakthrough can only be attempted there.

Beginner tip: Stay around Willowbank Village and Jade River City at first. Build your basics, earn some silver, meet local NPCs and learn how manuals work before travelling into more demanding regions.

Martial manuals & techniques

Discover manuals through ruins, old libraries, hidden caches and wandering masters. Rarity is rolled when you search; quality, completeness and hidden insights vary.

Drop rates: Common 50% · Uncommon 25% · Rare 15% · Earth 7% · Heaven 2.5% · Divine 0.5%
Passive meditation bonus from learned manuals: +0 Ki per session. Higher-quality Internal Arts grant stronger bonuses; mastery improves their effect. Joke manuals are easy to find but grant only a tiny bonus.

People of the martial world

NPCs have their own knowledge, temperament and offers. Speak to people where they are found.

Rumours & commissions

🎖 Life within your faction

Your allegiance is a responsibility. Train, complete duties, earn merit and rise through the ranks.

Factions of the Central Plains

Your allegiance becomes mandatory at Second-Rate Warrior and determines which headquarters you may enter after Peak Realm · Peak Stage.

⛰ Great Martial Sects

Each sect is a regional sub-faction beneath its alliance. You may join only one organisation in total, after meeting its existing requirements and passing its examination.

家 Prestigious Families

The great houses value reputation, talent and connections. You may be adopted as an honoured retainer or recognised as a family disciple; only one family affiliation can be held at a time.

⚖️ Your name in the martial world

Ways to shape your reputation

Good deeds

Aid a stranded traveller and spend 4 silver on provisions. Good reputation +3.

Shady dealings

Accept a discreet, dishonest commission for quick money. Bad reputation +3.
